newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed, seen rising.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Monday but traders said they could go up on Tuesday as treasury bill rates were expected to rise.
"It was just a sideways movement. There was not much action," a foreign bank dealer said.
Banks expected T-bill rates to rally during the regular weekly auction after the Central Bank late last week lifted its overnight borrowing rate to 10.0 from 9.9 percent.
The one-week, six and twelve-month rates rose, while the one-month rate dipped. The rest were steady.
